Harper (People Ops): Quick note — publishing a clarified Leaves & Time excerpt that distinguishes compassionate leave from bereavement, adds two pragmatic scenarios for managers, and links the accommodations request form. We're asking managers to complete a short 10-min microtraining + 6-question quiz. Company ack required by 2026-12-15. Links: https://tiny.redwood/leave-update | ack: https://tiny.redwood/ack

Mina (People Ops): Rollout details?

Harper (People Ops): Announcement goes out today. Managers: mandatory microtraining+quiz, window = 11 business days. ICs: please read + ack by 2026-12-15. Two live drop-ins scheduled (EMEA & APAC) plus recording.

Owen (HRBP): I'll add a "manager checklist" snippet and a regional callout for statutory differences (EU/UK/APAC). Also building an automated tracking export.

Kai (Eng Manager): Can we get a daily digest of manager completion statuses? Our leads prefer daily nudges. Also want SFTP ingest for our LMS.

training-bot: Training created: "Leaves: Compassionate vs Bereavement (2026-12)" Training ID: leaves-2026-12-01. Quiz ID: qz-leaves-2026-12-01. Results webhook: https://api.redwood.internal/training/results/leaves-2026-12-01

Mina (People Ops): CSV columns planned: manager_email,org_path,team_size,quiz_state,quiz_score,training_seen,ack_state,ack_ts,region,accom_request_flag,notes

Pri (Legal): Reviewed — clarificatory guidance, not a contractual amendment. If a contract or offer letter references a specific leave term, escalate to me before sending individualized ack requests. Add a privacy/contact line in ack copy.

Harper (People Ops): Pass = 85%. Reminders at day 4 and day 8; non-compliance after day 11 -> HRBP outreach. Fail twice -> short coaching session with HRBP.

Owen (HRBP): I'll take ownership of the exporter and a short "exceptions" column for legal flags.

Mina (People Ops): Exports: weekly CSV to sftp://hr-exports.redwood/handbook/leave-update/ (Fri 05:00 UTC) + webhook for near-real-time events. We'll also expose a results API for org integrations.

Kai (Eng Manager): Thanks — I'll push the manager roster and enable our LMS ingest. Please DM me the webhook creds.

Harper (People Ops): Action items: Harper post announcement + pinned links; Mina enable exports/webhook + API (owner); Owen coordinate regional review + exceptions (owner); Pri handle legal escalations. I'll post the manager email template in ~1 hour. Ping me for any edge cases. :white_check_mark:
